name: leopold
description: An autonomous orchestration harness: brief it like a teammate, it conducts your agent in your seat, deciding from your charter with git locked. Installing as a plugin also arms the git lock without a separate trust step.

interface.shortDescription: Autonomous runs from a brief you wrote, with git locked
interface.longDescription: Leopold turns a debated brief (mission, charter, guardrails, plan) into an autonomous run. It burns down the plan one item at a time, decides forks from your charter instead of asking, reviews each item before it closes, and keeps git commit and git push locked so shipping stays your call. Installing as a plugin arms both hooks — the git lock and the continuity engine that keeps the run going — without a separate trust step. You can also conduct a run headlessly with `leopold run --provider codex`.
defaultPrompt: /leopold-brief — debate the mission and write the brief
